summary_ja: 同時決済取引及び非同時決済取引に係る未決済取引の信用リスク・アセットの額の算出方法を定める。
summary_en: Prescribes the credit risk-weighted assets of unsettled transactions, covering delivery-versus-payment and non-delivery-versus-payment transactions.
paragraphs: Where the number of business days elapsed for a delivery-versus-payment transaction has reached five days or more, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall record, as the amount of credit risk-weighted assets of that transaction, the amount calculated by the formula in item (i) below, using the replacement cost of that transaction as EAD. In this case, the required capital ratio (K) needed to calculate the formula in that item shall be the ratio under item (ii): (i) Amount of credit risk-weighted assets = K × 12.5 × EAD; (ii) The required capital ratio (K) shall be as specified in the right column of the following table, according to the number of business days elapsed listed in the left column of that table. {{T:p189t0}}

With respect to the treatment of exposures relating to non-delivery-versus-payment transactions, where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach has delivered securities, etc. or paid funds to the counterparty of the non-delivery-versus-payment transaction and settlement of the counter-transaction has not been made, it shall comply with the following: (i) For the period from the day on which the securities, etc. were delivered or the funds were paid until four business days after the contractual settlement date of the counter-transaction, the contractual amount of that non-delivery-versus-payment transaction shall be the EAD, and the amount calculated pursuant to Article 129 or Article 138, according to the type of counterparty, shall be the amount of credit risk-weighted assets. (ii) From five business days after the contractual settlement date of the counter-transaction, the amount obtained by multiplying the contractual amount of that non-delivery-versus-payment transaction (the sum of that contractual amount and the replacement cost where the replacement cost of that non-delivery-versus-payment transaction exceeds zero) by a risk weight of 1,250% shall be the amount of credit risk-weighted assets.

In the case of item (i) of the preceding paragraph, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach may, notwithstanding that item, apply the following treatments to exposures relating to non-delivery-versus-payment transactions: (i) Where no internal rating has been assigned to the counterparty of the non-delivery-versus-payment transaction, use the PD corresponding to the rating assigned by an eligible credit rating agency; (ii) Treat the amount obtained by multiplying the contractual amount of the non-delivery-versus-payment transaction by the risk weights prescribed in Articles 22 through 34 as the amount of credit risk-weighted assets; (iii) Where the total amount of exposures relating to non-delivery-versus-payment transactions is recognized as not material, treat, for all of those non-delivery-versus-payment transactions, the amount obtained by multiplying the contractual amount by a risk weight of 100% as the amount of credit risk-weighted assets.

In the case of item (i) of the preceding paragraph, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the advanced internal ratings-based approach may, notwithstanding Article 133 or Article 141, set the LGD of the exposure relating to that non-delivery-versus-payment transaction at 45%.

Where any of the number of business days elapsed under paragraph (1) or the number of business days after the contractual settlement date under paragraph (2) is attributable to an overall failure of an external settlement system as a whole, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach may exclude those days from the number of business days elapsed under paragraph (1) or the number of business days after the contractual settlement date under paragraph (2).
